children: Insider trades occurred at firms including Goldman Sachs
and Procter & Gamble
this week. The following transactions occurred between October 26 and October 30.
Several Goldman Sachs

insiders sold their shares this week. CEO David Solomon sold 12,000 shares at prices ranging from $910.46 to $912.11, totaling about $10.93M. The sale accounted for about 5.92% of his holdings, leaving him with 190,556 shares.
Procter & Gamble
also saw several sales this week. CEO Shailesh Jejurikar sold 35,000 shares at $163.09 each for ~$5.71M. The transaction represented about 23.37% of his holdings, leaving him with 114,762 shares.
Texas Instruments
director Robert Sanchez sold 6,065 shares at about $302.21 each for $1.83M. The transaction represented about ~22% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 21,600 shares.
Delta Air Lines
CEO Edward Bastian sold 50,000 shares at $82 each for $4.1M. The sale accounted for about 3.67% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 1.31M shares.
United Parcel Service
Chief U.S. Domestic Officer Matthew Guffey sold 8,318 shares at $105.39 each for $876,628. The transaction represented about 96.84% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 271 shares.
Ares Capital
director Mary Henson purchased 2,500 shares at $18.46 each for $46,150, increasing her holdings to 36,969 shares.
Accenture
CEO Julie Sweet purchased 12,200 shares at about $245 - $246 each for around $3M, bringing her total holdings to 48,910 shares.
Truist Financial
CEO Michael Lyons acquired 25,000 shares at $48.36 each for $1.21M, increasing his holdings to 46,000 shares.
